en: My sister's illness
I just hope she gets better soon.
Why do doctors cost so much, anyway?
Well, the doctor here is a pretty decent guy,
and he's letting me pay later, though.
What do you want?
No business in an empty warehouse, right?
note: 'unused warehouse' -> 'empty warehouse' and subject dropped to fit the box (full wording is 2 lines; msg 21536 first box is 3 lines)

en: Don't just walk in here.
Anyway, you sure wear flashy clothes, huh?
You're that old man in the flashy clothes
(Of all the things to call me, "old man"!)
This place is off limits.
Stay out.
No business in an unused warehouse, right?
Anyone without business here keeps out.
Are you doing something here?
No. I got fired from the factory.
I'm unemployed now
There's no work at all.
note: reads with #627 'Not since I got fired from the factory.' in msg 22359

en: Your sister was worried about you.
She said you might be doing dangerous work.
Huh?
You know my sister?
Worried about what you're up to,
she's been out searching for you.
Sis.
She's still sick and hasn't recovered, yet
Truth is, I
I'm helping to smuggle goods
note: leading space: row follows #2 on the same line ('I... I'm helping'). Line 2 (#589) carries 'off the ships.'

en: off the ships.
Of course I know it's wrong, but...
I really needed the money.
I'm helping to smuggle goods
note: leading space as #588; 'trade' is in the msg 21719 variant of #589

en: I really need the money. But I don't
want to make my sister worry for nothing
What am I going to do?
I've decided. I'm just not cut out for
smuggling.
A guy named Brome at the sailors' inn
talked to me by chance, so I tried it, but
I think I'll turn it down now.
My sister's frail. After we came to this town,
she got sick.
The doctor treated her and she's a lot better,
but the medicine was expensive back then,
and I couldn't pay for it.
At the factory, just for coming from
elsewhere by ship, I got only awful jobs.
And then they suddenly fired me
I had to do something for my sister,
I needed the money.
So when a man named Brome at the sailors'
inn made me an offer, I took it.
But I'm done now. I'll collect the stolen
cargo and quietly put it all back.
You have dirtied your hands once already.
Next, for my sake,
you will do evil deeds.
Aaagh
Which rich family do you come from?
You really stand out in that getup.
You're not filthy rich, are you?
A rich kid like you probably
can't understand my worries
You're that rich kid in the flashy clothes
Anton, what kind of work are you doing
here?
Not since I got fired from the factory.
Your sister was worried about you.
She thought you might be doing some
kind of dangerous work.
Huh? You know my sister?
Worried about what you're up to,
, my master...
I await your orders...
I'm Heinrich, a navy soldier.
I'm on my way to guard the warehouse.
The warehouse is by the sea.
Civilians aren't allowed in.
Ah, Hans keeps popping into my head.
